description: For every finite atom set \(S\), valuation \(v\), and formula \(A\) whose atoms belong to \(S\), the signed context on \(S\) derives \(A\) if \(v\) makes \(A\) true and derives \(\neg A\) if \(v\) makes \(A\) false.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.derives_signed.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] (S : Finset α) (v : α → Bool)
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α) (hA : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.atoms A ⊆ S) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Derives (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.signedContext S v)
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.signed v A)
